preconditions.description: The length of the string n must be between 2 and 100.
There must be exactly 2n-2 strings provided as prefixes and suffixes.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) >= 1 and len(s) <= n - 1 for s in prefixes_and_suffixes)
preconditions.description: Each string must have a length between 1 and n-1.

postconditions.description: The output string must have a length of 2n-2.
The number of 'P' characters must equal the number of 'S' characters in the output.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'PS' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output string must consist only of the characters 'P' and 'S'.
